edges.reason: initialize stores the deposit token address into depositToken.
initialize stores the wrapped token address into xyWrappedToken.
initialize sets depositTokenDecimal.
setSwapper writes the swapper address.
setGasFeeReceiver writes the gas fee receiver.
setGasPriceConsumer writes the oracle address.
setCompleteDepositGasLimit writes the deposit gas limit.
setYieldRateBound writes maxYieldRateBound.
setYieldRateBound writes minYieldRateBound.
setCompleteWithdrawGasLimit writes the withdraw gas limit.
_getGasPrice reads the gasPriceConsumer address before the external call.
deposit accumulates the gas fee into depositAndWithdrawFees.
deposit increments numDeposits.
deposit writes a new DepositRequest into depositRequests.
deposit reads depositToken to decide ETH vs ERC20 handling.
deposit reads completeDepositGasLimit to compute gasFee.
withdraw accumulates the gas fee into depositAndWithdrawFees.
withdraw increments numWithdrawals.
withdraw writes a new WithdrawalRequest into withdrawalRequests.
withdraw reads completeWithdrawGasLimit to compute gasFee.
completeDeposit reads and updates the deposit request state.
completeDeposit validates the yield rate against maxYieldRateBound.
completeDeposit validates the yield rate against minYieldRateBound.
completeDeposit calls mint on xyWrappedToken.
completeWithdraw reads and updates the withdrawal request state.
completeWithdraw validates the yield rate against maxYieldRateBound.
completeWithdraw validates the yield rate against minYieldRateBound.
completeWithdraw uses depositToken to pay out the user.
receiveAssetFromSwapper accumulates closeSwapGasFees.
_collectDepositAndWithdrawGasFees reads and zeroes depositAndWithdrawFees.
_collectCloseSwapGasFees reads and zeroes closeSwapGasFees.
transferToSwapper requires the token to equal depositToken.
collectDepositAndWithdrawGasFees forwards to the internal fee helper.
collectCloseSwapGasFees forwards to the internal fee helper.
collectFees calls the deposit/withdraw fee helper.
collectFees calls the close-swap fee helper.
deposit pulls ERC20 deposit tokens via _safeTransferAssetFrom.
withdraw pulls wrapped tokens via _safeTransferAssetFrom.
completeWithdraw pays out via _safeTransferAsset.
transferToSwapper pays the swapper via _safeTransferAsset.
receiveAssetFromSwapper pulls assets via _safeTransferAssetFrom.
deposit performs an ETH refund transfer to msg.sender.
deposit executes an external safeTransferFrom on the deposit token.
withdraw performs an ETH refund transfer to msg.sender.
withdraw executes an external safeTransferFrom on the wrapped token.
transferToSwapper sends tokens out through _safeTransferAsset.
completeWithdraw sends deposit tokens out through _safeTransferAsset.
completeDeposit calls the external xyWrappedToken.mint.
completeWithdraw calls the external xyWrappedToken.burn.
_collectDepositAndWithdrawGasFees pays ETH to the receiver.
_collectCloseSwapGasFees may pay ETH to the receiver.
_collectCloseSwapGasFees may pay ERC20 tokens to the receiver.
_safeTransferAsset performs an external token transfer or ETH send.
_authorizeUpgrade gates the delegatecall-based upgrade path.
_getGasPrice makes an external call to the gas price oracle.
ETH refund transfer hands control to msg.sender during deposit.
ETH refund transfer hands control to msg.sender during withdraw.
External token transfer re-enters the vault while assets are being sent.
External token transferFrom can re-enter during balance-delta accounting.
Mint hook on the wrapped token can re-enter before state is fully consistent.
Burn hook on the wrapped token can re-enter before payout completes.
ETH fee payout re-enters the vault through the receiver.
ERC20 fee payout re-enters the vault through the receiver.
deposit records msg.sender as the deposit request owner and refund recipient.
withdraw records msg.sender as the withdrawal request owner and refund recipient.
onlySwapper restricts transferToSwapper to msg.sender equal to swapper.
onlySwapper restricts receiveAssetFromSwapper to msg.sender equal to swapper.
_depositToken parameter flows into depositToken assignment.
_xyWrappedToken parameter flows into xyWrappedToken assignment.
deposit amount parameter drives fee and request bookkeeping.
_depositID parameter indexes depositRequests.
amountXYWrappedToken is the divisor of the yield rate math, a zero value reverts the division.
amountXYWrappedToken parameter is stored in the withdrawal request.
_withdrawID parameter indexes withdrawalRequests.
amount parameter is used in yield rate math and payout.
withdrawFee joins amount in the checked multiplication used for the yield rate.
token parameter is compared against depositToken.
amount parameter determines the transfer size to the swapper.
receiver parameter is the ETH payout target in the fee helper.
receiver parameter is the payout target in the close-swap fee helper.
_swapper parameter is validated as a contract and stored.
_gasPriceConsumer parameter is validated as a contract and stored.
gasLimit parameter is stored as completeDepositGasLimit.
_maxYieldRateBound parameter is stored after the decimals require.
_minYieldRateBound parameter is stored as minYieldRateBound.
token parameter is compared against depositToken on asset receipt.
gasFeeAmount parameter is credited to closeSwapGasFees.
gasFee local accumulates into depositAndWithdrawFees and validates msg.value.
requiredValue local bounds the accepted msg.value.
id local keys the new depositRequests entry.
gasFee local accumulates into depositAndWithdrawFees in withdraw.
bal local measures the balance delta verifying the received amount.
_depositAndWithdrawFees local carries the amount paid out then zeroed.
_closeSwapGasFees local carries the amount paid out then zeroed.
amountXYWrappedToken parameter is the mint amount passed to the wrapped token.
amount parameter is the payout size sent by _safeTransferAsset.
amount parameter is the transfer size sent to the swapper.
amount parameter is the transferred amount in the safeTransferFrom call.
amountXYWrappedToken parameter is the transferred amount pulled from the user.
